headline: Lloyds Engineering Works notifies variation in rights issue object
sum: Lloyds Engineering Works Limited disclosed a variation in the stated objects of its rights issue, originally outlined in the Letter of Offer dated 19 April 2025, via NSE regulatory filing on 6 August 2026.
detail: The company informed the NSE of a material change to the object clause of its ongoing or recently concluded rights issue. The original Letter of Offer dated 19 April 2025 set out specific use-of-proceeds buckets; the variation implies a shift in capital allocation-whether for debt reduction, working capital, acquisitions, or capex redeployment. The filing mechanism (NSE General Updates) is the standard disclosure channel for listed companies to communicate changes in fundraising terms post-announcement.
